name: Python FastAPI backend + React/Vite frontend
description: uv-managed Python 3.12 backend (FastAPI, Pydantic v2, pytest, ruff, pyright strict) and a React 19 + Vite + TypeScript frontend (Vitest, Playwright). Hexagonal backend layers enforced with import-linter.

commands.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm ci
commands.test: cd backend && uv run pytest -q && cd ../frontend && npm test -- --run
commands.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pyright && cd ../frontend && npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit

backend_conventions: Type-checked with pyright strict; formatted and linted with ruff (line length 100).
`async` for I/O; wrap sync SDKs with `anyio.to_thread.run_sync`.
Pydantic v2 models at every boundary (API, LLM output, persistence).
Layers: `api -> services -> domain + ports`; `adapters` implement `ports`; `domain` is pure (no I/O, no SDKs, no clock). Enforced by import-linter in `backend/.importlinter`.
Errors: raise domain errors with a stable `code`; the API renders RFC 9457 problem+json.
Logging: structured JSON; bind request and entity IDs; never log secrets or personal data.
Money is `Decimal`, never float. Time is injected through a `Clock`; store UTC.
Tests in `backend/tests/{unit,integration,scenarios}`; an in-memory fake for every port in `backend/tests/fakes/`.
frontend_conventions: React 19 + Vite + TypeScript strict (`noUncheckedIndexedAccess`); no `any`; named exports only.
Feature-Sliced Design: `app -> pages -> widgets -> features -> entities -> shared`; import only downward.
API types are generated from `contracts/openapi.yaml`; never hand-write them.
Server state only through TanStack Query hooks in `entities/*/api.ts`.
Design values come from tokens; no raw colours, sizes or inline styles.
Every data panel has loading, empty and error states; every screen works from 360 px to 1600 px.
User-visible strings live in locale files, never literal in components.
Tests: Vitest + Testing Library + MSW; Playwright visual baselines at 390/834/1440 px.
